# Fixed ring planetary teaching rig

The existing `assembly.json` describes a teaching model, not a retail product.
The supplied parts may be separated vertically to explain their placement. This
is a presentation move, not a claim about an industrial disassembly procedure.

In a frame rotating with the carrier, the sun and planet have an external
mesh, while the planet and ring have an internal mesh. Equating pitch-line
velocities and eliminating the planet gives `Ns(ws-wc) = -Nr(wr-wc)`.
With `wr=0`, `ws=90 degrees/s`, `Ns=18` and `Nr=54`, the model's carrier
speed is `22.5 degrees/s`. The center of each planet follows the carrier at a
radius of 1.8 scene units. Curve height is an editorial offset so viewers can
see the path above the moving parts, not a claim that the planet rises.

Excluded: tooth contact, backlash, forces, stress, friction, efficiency,
manufacturing fit, industrial disassembly procedure and product identification.
